title: Visibility ablation (generated traffic)
claim: The controlled instrument: four visibility profiles on traffic where we know the ground truth.

title: The visibility ladder
claim: Each rung removes one thing a diode-side sensor cannot see.

title: First real-corpus run
claim: On CIC-IDS2017, retraining under the deployment profile recovered only a third of the loss.

title: What a one-way tap actually costs
claim: The tap costs 0.29 binary-F1 with per-flow features, and essentially nothing once the sensor keeps host state.

title: Streaming sketches vs exact batch
claim: 14 of 16 features reproduce bitwise; the one disagreement never reaches the model.

title: The lateness budget
claim: 15s buys back 12% of flows. It does not buy accuracy - prediction V4 refuted.

title: Sharding vs line rate
claim: 672 Mbps measured against a 1 Gbps target. Four predictions refuted.

title: Why calibration must be per class
claim: A marginal predictor reports 0.883 coverage while abstaining on 95-100% of six of seven classes.

title: Detector heads, tested
claim: Starving a head of features costs 40x what splitting into heads is worth.

title: Low-rate diffuse attacks
claim: Our own headline, attacked: the one-way tap result holds, host-window-alone does not.
